scope: fixed before any development model diagnosis; label-blind public telemetry only

priority.selection: valid root OSB spans (case-insensitive callType OSB, empty parent id) with finite elapsedTime; at least minimum_support distinct traceId values in each window
priority.summary: mean, median, empirical q90, and distinct trace support per window
priority.units: source elapsedTime units are undeclared; compare this field only

priority.selection: if no supported root OSB elapsedTime, choose serviceName with greatest paired finite avg_time timestamp support; support is at least minimum_support unique timestamps in each window
priority.summary: mean, median, empirical q90, and unique timestamp support per window
priority.units: source avg_time units are undeclared; compare this field only

priority.selection: if neither latency field is supported, valid root OSB success observations with at least minimum_support distinct traceId values in each window
priority.summary: failures / valid status observations and denominator per window

abstention: If no KPI satisfies paired support, report unsupported and do not invent a KPI.
